title: Disco Phantom in Ruins
description: A surreal scene featuring a large reflective disco ball hanging from a dark ornate ceiling, casting light over a decaying ballroom. A ghostly figure in flowing orange and blue robes with a skeletal face stands on the right, while distorted shadowy figures and fragmented forms swirl chaotically across the left and floor.
prompt: Surreal dark ballroom scene with a large sparkling disco ball hanging from an ornate ceiling. A spectral figure with a skeletal mask wears flowing orange and deep blue robes that billow dramatically. Chaotic swirling abstract shadowy forms and fragmented figures explode across the left side and wooden floor. Dramatic cinematic lighting with strong contrast, painterly brushwork, dark moody atmosphere.
